label: Gemma 4 E2B (local)
serve: Ollama (0.31.1): `ollama pull gemma4:e2b` (4.6 GB, Q4_K_M, vision and tools), then the Ollama server answers /v1/chat/completions on its own port. See docs/local-models.md.
notes: Probed 2026-11-14 with pc/tools/probe_model.py: takes the 1344 px sheet; json_object, json_schema and prompt-only all fit the overview and events schemas; tool calls 9 of 9; the first call loads the model (62 s), later ones take 1 to 7 s; six calls at once take as long as six in a row, so max_parallel is 1; reasoning_effort none removes the reasoning tokens of unconstrained replies (390 down to 15); think: false does nothing. detail is accepted and ignored, so it is not sent.
